title: Sealed push envelope (the APNs payload's "oc" object)
description: Everything here except ct is visible to the relay and Apple. aad = "oc1|" + kind + "|" + exp + "|" + kid.

kid.description: The device key ID for one paired server, chosen by the app.

exp.description: Expiry in Unix seconds. The envelope is expired once now >= exp.

enc.description: The 32-byte X25519 encapsulated key, base64url without padding.

ct.description: ChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext and tag of the padded plaintext (528, 1040 or 2064 bytes), base64url without padding.
